schedule.timezone_note: Runner: every hour. Digest: 22:00 UTC = 06:00 AWST

claude.note: Pinned deliberately. Leave either value empty to fall back to the CLI default. Sessions ran claude-sonnet-4-6 (the unpinned default) until 2026-07-30. generation_effort applies only to ticket-generation sessions: proposing the wrong work is more expensive than thinking about it for longer.

linear.note: Benedict's cap, 2026-08-06. Was 40/15/40 turns, which produced 30 untriaged tickets and 13 in one day. The band is now 10-15: generate below 10, hard stop at 15, so a full backlog blocks new proposals until he triages. Fewer, better-researched tickets is the trade: generation sessions get 3x the turns and a higher effort setting. stale_backlog_days is the untriaged-to-Cancelled horizon.
